MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The screw-mounted magnets felt useful for removable workshop mounting, connecting naturally with my past fasteners and practical assembly supplies.",
    "The self-fusing tape fits the wiring work suggested by my battery holder, breadboards, PCB supplies, and relay module because it could help insulate and protect connections."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The endoscope, specific tap and die set, and pressure safety valve each require a particular job or compatible equipment that I have not shown a need for.",
    "The glue accelerators assume an ongoing super glue project, while packing paper and pH calibration solutions serve activities absent from my history.",
    "The temperature controller is loosely related to my infrared thermometer, but measuring surface temperature does not establish a need to automate heating and cooling."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in practical tools seems to have been stretched into interest in almost any specialized workshop equipment.",
    "Shared ideas such as fastening or temperature seem to have mattered more than whether the items serve the same task."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Several of my purchases work together for small electronics assembly; supplies that support wiring and mounting feel more relevant than tools for unrelated repair jobs.",
    "I choose selectively when an item has a clear use. An isolated purchase, especially one years ago, does not mean I currently need accessories for a larger project."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my practical assembly interests but extended them too broadly into specialized tasks I have no current reason to pursue."
}
